title: Astro Portal session event envelope
description: The shape a client submits to POST /v1/sessions/{id}/events, one entry per array item (packages/portal/src/persistence/migrations.ts migration 17, table session_events). `eventId` is a client-generated ULID and is the idempotency key together with the session: resubmitting the same (session, eventId) pair is a silent no-op, never a duplicate or an error. `recordedAt` is the device's own clock and is informational only — it is never trusted for ordering or for the debrief's night-window detection, both of which use the server-assigned `receivedAt`. `type` and `payload` are validated against the matching schema named in session-events.md; an unknown `type`, or a `payload` that fails its schema, is rejected by the server rather than stored. The envelope never carries the originating device nor the `source` of the event: the server derives both from the caller's device bearer token.

eventId.description: Client-generated ULID (Crockford base32, 26 characters). Generated once per event and replayed unchanged on every retry.

type.description: One of the registered session-event types; see session-events.md for the full registry. A reader MUST tolerate a type it does not know (a newer service may send one): it shows an ordinary report, never an error.

payload.description: Validated against the JSON Schema named for this `type` in session-events.md (session-events/<type>.schema.json). Left generic here because this envelope schema cannot express a type-conditional payload shape.

recordedAt.description: The device clock at the moment the event was captured, not when it reached the server. Informational only.
